Shared implementation for actor/gid measure functions

Source: R/rebeltrack_measure_impl.R
dot-rebeltrack_measure_impl.Rd

Shared implementation for actor/gid measure functions

.rebeltrack_measure_impl(
  x,
  group_col,
  var,
  fill,
  lag,
  weight,
  lag_engine,
  constructor,
  summarise,
  make_group = .simple_group()
)

Arguments

x

A RebelTrackDataFrame or RebelTrackDataFrameGid object

group_col

The grouping column for this measure (actor or priogrid_gid)

var

Name of the variable to create (already resolved to a string, e.g. via rlang::quo_name(rlang::enquo(var)))

fill

Default value when no events are observed in the specified period.

lag

An integer giving the number of positions to lead or lag by.

weight

A weight matrix to apply.

lag_engine

weighted_lag or weighted_lag_gid

constructor

.rebeltrack_dataframe or .rebeltrack_dataframe_gid

summarise

A function(group) that returns the group summary data frame via dplyr::summarize(group, .var = value), where value is this measure's computed column

make_group

A function(events, group_col) that returns a tibble grouped by group_col and period_start (after whatever intermediate mutate/group_by/summarize steps this particular measure needs), ready to be summarised. Defaults to .simple_group(), which covers every measure that just groups by group_col and period_start with no intermediate stage.
